normalization_plan.reason: amount parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer, where fees and limits are applied
sender parameter is a temporary binding of msg.sender inside _transfer
recipient parameter is a temporary binding used only by _transfer/_executeTransfer
fees local is the direct input of the fee arithmetic unsafe operation
contractTokenBalance local is a read-only snapshot consumed by _executeSwap
nativeDividends local is computed and spent inside _executeSwap
account parameter is consumed by _withdrawDividendOfUser and its payout call
_withdrawableDividend local is the exact value passed to the low-level ETH call
swapTokensDividends local is an intermediate of _executeSwap BPS arithmetic
_users array parameter is iterated only by the blacklist functions to write isBlacklisted
